tasks.short: Maintain exchange, authorisation and reconciliation records

steps.what: Retrieve actual completed exchange records and authorisation references from the casino cage category of {OTHER}
Identify and capture missing signed forms and unresolved transaction references for the record set
Assemble accurate records of monetary exchanges and authorisation forms in the cage-record category of {OTHER}
Reconcile transaction totals and authorisation references in the cage-record category of {OTHER}; investigate differences rather than force a balance
Check the completed record set and reconciliation against source exchanges, signatures and unresolved exceptions
Commit the checked record snapshot in the cage-record category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Configure the casino cage category of {OTHER} to index transaction and form references and show reconciliation differences. The cashier captures missing evidence, resolves discrepancies and checks the completed record set before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exchange references and signed forms can require manual matching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native transaction identifiers and totals support deterministic linking and comparison.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical match does not establish that an authorisation is valid or a cash discrepancy is explained.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier recognises missing evidence and knows when an unresolved difference must be escalated.
tasks.altitude: Less record assembly; unchanged accountability for exceptions.

reach.learn: Present source evidence without changing or concealing differences.

evidence.claim: Structured transaction identifiers allow record linking and total comparisons without a model.

assumptions: Boundary is record maintenance after actual exchanges, not accepting money or posting those transactions. Drawer counting is owned by task 6998 and consumed as an existing input here, with no second counting credit.

Completed transactions supply immutable transaction ID, cashier, shift, timestamp, tender, value and authorisation reference; the cashier captures missing signed-form ID and exception notes in s2. Missing IDs require manual matching and remain flagged. Actual capture is counted.

Native configuration is tested first. Shares describe an unconfigured record-maintenance scenario, not a measured baseline. Existing runtime earns no saving. No new report send or additional approval role is assumed; s5 is the ordinary final record check.
unknowns: Whether forms and transactions already link natively
Which exceptions require supervisor review under local policy
research_questions: How much matching remains manual after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Record matching, reconciliation exception work and final review remain in s3-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain link rules and resolve changed export fields.

approvals.approved_version: Completed record set and reconciliation checked in s5; any edit voids the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Manual matching and reconciliation offer 20 gross hours less 2 upkeep, or 18 net. Fully linked existing records give no added benefit. Missing evidence capture and final verification retain all effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange customer money, tickets and chips

steps.what: Establish the customer's requested exchange and permissible tender at the booth
Count and authenticate the money, credit evidence, tickets or casino chips presented by the customer
Calculate exchange value and change and enter the transaction draft in the casino cage category of {OTHER}
Stage and count the outgoing money or chips and check the final exchange draft, payout, tender and customer before posting or handing anything over
Post the exact checked exchange in the casino cage category of {OTHER}
Hand the checked payout and change to the identified customer and complete the exchange

tasks.design: Use native denomination and change calculation in the casino cage category of {OTHER}. The cashier still authenticates and counts tender, stages and checks the final exchange, posts it and hands over the exact checked payout.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated denomination arithmetic can remain manual despite a digital transaction form.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tender tables and exact-value arithmetic can populate a draft.
tasks.still_hard: Counterfeits, damaged tickets, customer disputes and physical custody need a person.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier checks what was actually received and delivered.

ambition.what: No autonomous payments or wider gambling access.

reach.learn: Preserve the transaction evidence and escalate discrepancies.

evidence.claim: Native denomination arithmetic can draft change from verified tender amounts.

assumptions: Boundary is an ordinary authorised booth exchange. Eligibility checks belong to task 21153; specialist credit approval and other-role work are excluded with no savings attributed to them.

The cashier produces tender type, verified value and requested denomination in s1-s3. The cage administrator supplies approved denomination and conversion tables. Missing or invalid values stop calculation and require manual handling, counted in s3-s4.

Native configuration first; no runtime saving. Provisional shares assume some manual arithmetic, not a measured baseline. The existing final payout check in s4 occurs after the completed draft and physical payout exist; any content, tender or customer change requires rechecking. Record maintenance in 6999 is separate from the transaction post here.
unknowns: Whether change is already calculated natively
Which exchanges require additional existing authorisation
research_questions: Is there any repeated arithmetic left to remove?

already_counted.description: Transaction review and staged-payout verification remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Check denomination configuration when accepted tender changes.

approvals.approved_version: Final exchange draft checked in s4; edits void approval.
Exact staged payout, customer and exchange snapshot checked in s4 and posted unchanged in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 10 percent arithmetic changes: 6 gross less 0.5 upkeep gives 5.5 net. Existing native calculation means no improvement. Counting, authenticity, posting and handover keep their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Count money in the drawer by denomination and capture actual counted quantities in the casino cage category of {OTHER}
Audit money drawers by comparing counted denomination values against expected shift totals in the cage category of {OTHER}
Investigate differences, recount as needed and write and check the final drawer audit result without concealing unresolved discrepancies
Save the exact checked drawer audit result in the cage category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Test native count-entry and expected-total comparison in the casino cage category of {OTHER}. Counted denominations generate a variance draft, while actual counting, recounts and discrepancy explanations remain fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual multiplication and comparison can accompany a physical cash count.
tasks.enabler_now: Denomination tables and posted transaction totals support deterministic comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: A total cannot reveal where missing cash went.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier maintains custody and investigates actual discrepancies.
tasks.altitude: Less summation, unchanged counting and accountability.

reach.learn: Distinguish evidence from an unsupported explanation.

evidence.claim: Structured denomination counts and expected totals permit deterministic drawer comparison.

assumptions: Boundary is the cashier's actual drawer count and audit, excluding other-role independent checks and later record-set maintenance in 6999.

The cashier produces denomination, actual quantity, shift and drawer ID in s1 including entry time. Posted transactions provide expected balance and tender totals. Missing or disputed entries require manual reconstruction in s2-s3; expected values never substitute for an actual count.

Native configuration first; provisional shares are not measured baselines. Normal final audit checking is in s3 after the result exists, with no added self-approval ceremony. Saving keeps its full one-percent effort.
unknowns: Whether native totals already replace manual sums
research_questions: Does native count entry remove any current calculation work?

already_counted.description: Comparison review and discrepancy work remain in s2-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain denomination definitions and check changed shift-total fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final audit result checked in s3, including open discrepancies; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Comparison saves 10 gross hours less 1 upkeep, or 9 net in a manual-summation scenario. Already configured totals give no additional saving. Actual cash counts, explanations and saving are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check identification presented by the player for authenticity, validity and a match to the person
Compare the verified birth date with the applicable age threshold and resolve unclear or unacceptable identification under the existing procedure

tasks.design: Keep the existing identification inspection and age comparison. No recording, admission transaction or report is stated here, and no assumed administrative baseline supports adding one.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work requires checking a physical person against the presented document.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change to that work is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Altered documents, resemblance and unclear validity need human handling.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier can stop and seek help when the identification does not establish eligibility.

reach.learn: Escalate uncertainty with minimum necessary disclosure.

evidence.claim: A document date check alone does not establish authenticity or that the document belongs to the player.

assumptions: Boundary is checking identification and determining age, excluding the separate admission or exchange action. No document copy, record write, send or report is required by this task statement; local requirements must be established before assuming such work.

Inputs are the actual player and document, the operator-maintained applicable age rule and current date. Inspection and reading are counted in s1-s2. Missing or doubtful documentation is handled manually under the existing procedure.
No new configuration, data capture or ongoing tool is proposed; native arithmetic alone would not materially change these physical checks. Shares are illustrative, not measured.
unknowns: Which identification documents and local procedures apply
Whether a separate existing admission process records the check
research_questions: Is there real required record work beyond this inspection task?

already_counted.description: All document checking and age determination remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: No new tool or procedure is introduced; zero additional upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No change to actual inspection or eligibility judgement is proposed. No unobserved reporting or copying baseline is invented, and no new tool means zero upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Cash custody, eligibility checks and exception accountability remain human.
reach: Give cash-office supervisors traceable discrepancy evidence.
role.ambitious_version: A cashier who can trace each exchange and discrepancy without surrendering control of cash or identification checks.

job.title: Gambling Change Persons and Booth Cashiers
